description: This file defines the ServerRequest class implementing the ServerRequestInterface as part of the PSR-7 HTTP message interfaces. It manages HTTP server request data, including attributes, headers, cookies, query parameters, body, uploaded files, and server parameters. The class provides methods to construct, modify, and retrieve request information.

classes.name: ServerRequest
classes.description: Implementation of the PSR-7 ServerRequestInterface. Handles HTTP server request details such as headers, URI, method, body, cookies, query parameters, uploaded files, and attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ServerRequest with method, URI, headers, body, protocol version, and server parameters.

methods.name: getServerParams
methods.description: Returns the server parameters, typically from $_SERVER.

methods.name: getUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns the array of uploaded files.

methods.name: withUploadedFiles
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified uploaded files.

methods.name: withCookieParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified cookie parameters.

methods.name: withQueryParams
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified query parameters.

methods.name: getParsedBody
methods.description: Returns the parsed body content, which can be array, object, or null.

methods.name: withParsedBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified parsed body data.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns a specific attribute by name, or default if not present.

methods.name: withAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified attribute set.

methods.name: withoutAttribute
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified attribute.
